title: Enrich a case without rewriting its definition
preconditions: A separate planned case r1 has stable step IDs; save its identity and original revision bytes.

steps.action: Add implementation evidence, revise the expected outcome to r2, and append superseding evidence.
steps.expected_result: Evidence addition preserves the existing r1 revision; old evidence becomes stale after r2, both revisions and evidence records remain, and original r1 bytes stay unchanged.

expected_result: Enrich a case without rewriting its definition.
